text:
[RARC.7.15] A pump retracts the expired `ttl` facts at its entry, before
anything fires ([RARC.5.6.3]): a fact expires when its deadline is at or before
the clock ([RARC.5.2.4]). An input does not: an assert made after a fact's
deadline joins against that fact until the next pump retracts it. Each
retraction is its own event with its own `seq`, and the logical retractions it
causes cascade through truth maintenance.

---
